SOLO PROJECT
MISSION_01 // FLAGSHIP
Defect Detection via NeRF & 3D Gaussian Splatting
End-to-end pipeline for industrial HDD surface inspection. Benchmarked Nerfacto, Instant-NGP, and Splatfacto — Splatfacto achieving 38.28 dB PSNR and 27.17 FPS vs Nerfacto's 22.95 dB / 0.40 FPS. Anomaly scoring via DBSCAN clustering, RANSAC plane segmentation, OBB canonicalisation, ICP registration, and GPU-accelerated Chamfer Distance.

MISSION_05 // EMBEDDED SYSTEMS
ESP32-C3 Dual-Signal Waveform Generator
Bare-metal waveform generator on ESP32-C3 using both Arduino IDE and ESP-IDF / FreeRTOS. Generated surname-coded DATA & SYNC signals (a=1100µs, b=2600µs, 11 pulses, d=6500µs) with Normal and Reverse-Pulse modes, verified on oscilloscope.

GROUP PROJECT · HWU GROUP 40
MISSION_06 // F20RO · GROUP 40 · TEAM PROJECT
Bio-Inspired Robot Control — BBR & Evolutionary Robotics
Three-task Intelligent Robotics coursework on the e-puck platform in Webots. Task 1 (BBR): Proportional ground-sensor delta line follower with high-priority obstacle avoidance (proximity threshold 0.06, tight-pivot logic). Task 2 (BBR): Braitenberg Aggression phototaxis — Supervisor-controlled dynamic corner lights, Wide Curve Search when ambient light < 4000, random corner-switch triggered within 0.4 m of active light. Task 3 (ER): GA-evolved 11-input MLP (3 ground + 8 proximity) on Speed World circuit; adaptive mutation 22% → 4% over 50 generations; emergent wall-surfing "Daredevil" strategy; best fitness 0.65 at Gen 45.
